pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Fianchetto, Modern, 5...Nf6
pages.notes: Overview said 6.Nxc6 bxc6 leads to a Maroczy Bind; plans 2-3 targeted a c6-pawn not yet there. Rewrote overview and plans 2-3 around 6.Nxc6 bxc6 7.e5; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Fianchetto, Modern, 5...Nf6 6.Nxc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 targeted a c6-pawn not yet recaptured with a 'minority attack'; overview and plan 2 called the b-file open. Rewrote plans 1-2; fixed the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Fianchetto, Modern, 6.Be3 Nf6 7.f3
pages.notes: Plans wrote castling as 0-0-0 and 0-0 and played ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Fianchetto, Modern, 6.Nb3
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 set up a Maroczy Bind with c4, which the c3-knight blocks; plan 4 rerouted an f3-knight that isn't there; plan 2 mentioned a Hedgehog. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2, 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense, Dragon Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 offered Rxc6 and Bxh6 sacrifices that don't fit the position. Rewrote plan 1 around the Yugoslav Attack; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Accelerated Dragon, Modern Bc4 Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 sacrificed with Nxf7, which no knight can play. Rewrote plan 1 around Bb3 and the choice of castling; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Fianchetto, Modern, 7.Bc4 O-O 8.f3
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted the queen Qe1-g3 with the king still on e1; plan 3 sacrificed on e6 where there is no pawn. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4, adding 8...Qb6.

pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Fianchetto, Modern, 7.Bc4 O-O 8.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file; plan 2 missed the 8...Nxe4 9.Nxe4 d5 fork trick. Rewrote plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, 5...d6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named d4 as a move. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Maroczy Bind, 5...Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted a knight via e8-d6; plan 1 expanded with an a4-b4 route; plan 2 wrote Black's moves without dots. Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4; British spelling in plan 3.
